definitions.explanation: A specific instance or example of something that has occurred, often used as a reference or precedent. Common in academic, legal, and business contexts.

examples.japanese: {過去|かこ}の{事例|じれい}を{調|しら}べた。
{成功|せいこう}{事例|じれい}を{参考|さんこう}にして{計画|けいかく}を{立|た}てた。
examples.english: I made a plan by referring to successful cases.

examples.japanese: {同|おな}じような{事例|じれい}が{全国|ぜんこく}で{報告|ほうこく}されており、{対策|たいさく}が{急|いそ}がれている。
examples.english: Similar cases have been reported nationwide, and countermeasures are urgently needed.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {成功|せいこう}{事例|じれい} (success story, successful case)
- {事例|じれい}{研究|けんきゅう} (case study)
- {過去|かこ}の{事例|じれい} (past cases)
- {事例|じれい}を{紹介|しょうかい}する (to introduce examples)
- {具体的|ぐたいてき}な{事例|じれい} (concrete example)

REGISTER: {事例|じれい} is a formal word used in written and professional contexts. In casual conversation, {例|れい} or {例|たと}え is more natural for "example."
